description: The asiman is the living vampire-witch of Fon and Ewe tradition, documented in Dahomey (now Benin) and shared with neighboring West African peoples. An ordinary-looking woman by day, at night she leaves her body to fly as a corpse-candle or ball of light, drains the blood of sleeping victims, and takes animal form after feeding. She is destroyed only in that animal form.
source: Fon/Dahomey oral tradition; godsandmonsters.info (Asiman); Occult World; vampire folklore references
research_notes: Verified via godsandmonsters.info, Occult World, Academic Dictionaries and vampire-folklore compilations: the asiman is the Dahomean (Benin) witch-vampire, kin to the Ashanti obayifo and Ewe adze. Input lists Ghana as country, but the figure is best documented in Benin; the Akan equivalent is the obayifo.

description: Da (Aido-Hwedo) is the primordial rainbow-serpent of Fon Vodun cosmology: the cosmic support said to have coiled beneath the earth to hold the universe stable, companion of the creator Mawu-Lisa. The rainbow is his manifestation. At Ouidah, living royal pythons are honored as his incarnations, and in the diaspora he endures as Damballa in Haitian Vodou.
source: Fon Vodun cosmology; Ouidah Python Temple; Wikipedia (Da, Aido-Hwedo, Damballa)
research_notes: Standard attested Fon deity with solid documentation (coils around earth, companion of Mawu, Ouidah pythons, Damballa in Haiti). Input framing folded in; no corrections needed.

description: The Dodo is the great bush-spirit and bogeyman of Hausa tradition in Niger and northern Nigeria, an ancient deity of the dry season whose wife Damina brings the rains. A giant, cannibalistic being of forests, swamps and baobab trees, he seizes those who stray from home; his tales enforce obedience, community and respect for boundaries.

research_notes: Verified via Oxford Reference: Dodo is an evil spirit, an ancient deity, father of the cardinal directions, masculine power lying between east and south, associated with the dry season, dried vegetation and thunder; opposed by his wife Damina (rainy season). The 'Swallower-of-Men' monster role also documented.
